minor-metals-value-chain.title: The minor metals value chain
minor-metals-value-chain.description: From mineral feedstocks to qualified industrial materials. Expand a segment to inspect company and product examples.
minor-metals-value-chain.note: Figure 1. Companies can span stages. Connections show functional categories, not verified supply contracts, except the explicitly labelled 5N Plus to First Solar CdTe agreement [E11]. Nyrstar’s Port Pirie antimony example refers to the demonstration-plant shipment announced on 17 February 2026 [E01], not the potential 5,000-tonne annual expansion. 6N and 7N denote 99.9999% and 99.99999% purity. Examples are illustrative and unranked; source IDs resolve in the appendix.

sources.title: Evidence and methods: E01, E03–E11, E13 and E14

minor-metals-antimony-2024.title: Antimony mine production by country
minor-metals-antimony-2024.metric: Share of reported mine production by contained metal (%)
minor-metals-antimony-2024.scope: BGS reported world mine production: 105,000 metric tonnes of contained metal in the 2024 statistical period. Production geography, not company revenue share or refined-metal supply.
minor-metals-antimony-2024.rounding_note: Each percentage is independently rounded to one decimal place. Displayed percentages may not total exactly 100%; slice areas use the original tonnes.

source.publisher: British Geological Survey; N. E. Idoine et al.
source.title: [E02] World Mineral Production 2020–24
source.locator: Printed p. 5; Antimony table, 2024 column, country rows and rounded world total.

minor-metals-antimony-2024.note: Figure 2. Slice areas use raw tonnes; labels are independently rounded to one decimal. Other and rounding = 105000 - (45000 + 27500 + 15000 + 4817 + 4548) = 8135 tonnes. The residual includes the difference caused by the published rounded world total; it is not an independently observed country total. BGS includes antimony content of antimonial lead alloys; some observations are estimates and country year ends differ. Source E02.

minor-metals-tungsten-2024.note: Figure 3. Slice areas use raw tonnes; labels are independently rounded to one decimal. Other and rounding = 75500 - (59000 + 5394 + 2127 + 1800 + 1587) = 5592 tonnes.
